title: Mothers who build
summary: A stream of consciousness By Haya Odeh, Co-founder & Head of Design, Replit May 2026 From the moment I got married, the question started. When are you having children? Then, once I had them: How are you still doing this? Why do you even need a job? Your husband is providing. I heard versions of that my entire career. The assumption underneath it, that a woman's ambition has a natural stopping point, that motherhood is where the building ends, is something I've been quietly arguing against for over a decade. Let me try to form my thoughts around this in answers to questions I’ve heard from others or pondered myself. Questions that mothers out there can relate to.
